title: Feedback-loop stability via gain and phase margin
body:
The stability of a closed-loop control system can be characterised by its gain margin and phase margin.
[Step] Linearisation
  [Input] equilibrium operating point, [Tool] Bode plot
[Step] Margin measurement
  [Output] gain margin = 12 dB, phase margin = 55°
A smaller gain margin means the loop is closer to sustained oscillation under modest plant variation. This is a textbook interpretation in classical control and is still the basis of practical PID tuning on the shop floor.
